{"parts":["review-card","history-card"],"criterion":"TASK-AC-010B47E192B5","difference":"The duration and focus readings (and a saved record’s date) show their glyph and value, their term kept for ass

`SummaryFacts` takes `facts` that carry their `FactKind` and orders, glyphs and sets the term visibility of each by its kind (marked `data-overview-facts`); given children only, as the overview state passes them, it draws exactly as before.
Review’s Overview hands its facts to `SummaryFacts` with their kinds (and the movement count as `movements`), in place of its label-keyed glyph, order and term tables; it draws the same readings.

The saved Overview’s facts carry their kinds (Review’s glyphs, order and term visibility over the record’s own values) and the card gains Round 7’s `EquipmentSummary` built from the saved `equipment_used`. No state draws `/history/:id`.
